This is the part written into the prompt. Each tool\'s full description is sent separately with every request.
Within a conversation, memory, profile and tools are fixed at the start. After a refresh, Orbit reads them again on its next reply.

On its next reply, Orbit reads its memory, profile and tools again and builds the whole prompt anew. That reply is a little slower and uses more tokens.
